title: MSFS 2024 PC Marketplace Update (Feb 28, 2026) Changi 2026 + 5 NEW airports you don’t want to miss!
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (Feb 28): The imaginesim WSSS Singapore Changi 2026, iniBuilds EFKT Kittila, and new MSFS 2024 Scenery are live! This Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update is for PC.

Today’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update features the massive WSSS Singapore Changi 2026 by imaginesim, plus iniBuilds Kittila (EFKT) and mxidesign Stockholm Vasteras (ESOW). This MSFS PC Update also includes a huge wave of DreamScenery water fixes and Night Lighting enhancements.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 iniBuilds: EFKT Kittila Airport (Perfect for snowy Lapland ops and winter approaches)
🛫 mxidesign: ESOW Stockholm Vasteras Airport (A great Sweden pick for regional hops)
🛫 NMG Simulations: FABL Bloemfontein International Airport (Solid South Africa route addition)
🛫 Beautiful Model of the World: LEVX Vigo (Gorgeous coastal Spain flying potential)
🛫 imaginesim: WSSS Singapore Changi Airport 2026 (Major international hub — huge route variety)
